text:
They always ask us

to understand the point of view

of others

no matter whether it is

outdated

foolish

disgusting.

One is asked

to understand

kindly

all the errors of others

their wasted lives

especially if they are

advanced in age.

But their age is the only thing

we notice.

They have aged

badly

because they have

lived

without focus,

they have refused

to see.

Is it not their fault?

whose fault?

mine?

I am asked to hide

my opinion

before them

for fear of their

fear.

Age is not a crime

but the shame

of a life

deliberately

wasted

among so many

lives

deliberately

wasted

is.

translation.title: They Always Ask Us...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the accusatory line breaks and the distinction between age itself and deliberate waste.
